about_short_description.short_description: Ellipsis provides automated AI-powered code reviews, automated bug fixes, and ftware development workflows.

product.name: AI Code Reviews & Bug Fixes
product.description: Automated code reviews that detect logical bugs, style violations, and antipatterns on every commit and pull request.

product.name: Async Code Generation
product.description: Generates working, tested code based on tasks assigned via GitHub comments.

product.name: Question & Answers
product.description: Enables developers to ask questions directly via GitHub comments and receive AI-generated answers.

product.name: Style Guide-as-code
product.description: Allows teams to write style guides in natural language, which Ellipsis uses to flag violations automatically.

product.name: Customize with Feedback
product.description: Learns from team feedback to tailor the types of review comments Ellipsis provides over time.

product.name: Generate Change Logs
product.description: Creates weekly summaries of codebase changes and their significance.
